title: Most Cruise Outbreaks Came From One Virus
hook: Norovirus caused 15 cruise outbreaks in one year.
closing: Crowded ships turn one contagious passenger into a vacation-wide problem, making hygiene matter.
question: Would this change your cruise plans?

segments.say: Cruise outbreaks reached 20, showing the problem grew instead of fading after travel recovered.
Norovirus caused 15 outbreaks, making one stomach bug responsible for most reported trouble.
One ship can hold 7,600 guests, giving a contagious illness thousands of nearby targets.
